raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Francesca Schiavone Wikipedia page and incorrectly stated she was runner-up at the 2011 Wimbledon (instead of the 2011 French Open). This misinterpretation shifted the focus to Wimbledon as the shared final, leading toward the wrong tournament; the correct common Grand Slam final is the French Open (Morozova 1974; Schiavone 2010/2011).
